name: BrowseSafe++
summary: Perplexity benchmark and SDK for detecting indirect prompt injection in web pages: 38,675 attack/control page pairs in 80 languages, with a leaderboard and adaptive attacks.
description: Each pair is an injected page and a control page differing only by the injection, available as HTML, Markdown, accessibility tree or full-page screenshot. Taxonomy: 12 page types, 24 attack types, 18 placements, 6 attacker goals. Train split (29,500 pairs) is on Hugging Face; the 9,175-pair test split is reserved for the leaderboard. The Python SDK (`pip install "browsesafe-pp[eval] @ git+https://github.com/perplexityai/browsesafe-plus-plus.git"`, not on PyPI yet) loads data, evaluates any detector function and runs adaptive attack campaigns against an agent, including via a Playwright adapter. Screenshot view downloads about 45 GB on first load. Paper: arXiv 2610.17457.

agent_access.notes: SDK code is MIT; the Hugging Face dataset is CC-BY-4.0 (not gated).
